item.title: Gloria Steinem, a potent voice of US feminism and co-founder of Ms. Magazine, dies at 92
item.description: Steinem became the most visible symbol and potent voice of the U.S. women’s movement in the ‘60s and ‘70s and a fierce advocate for feminist causes for the rest of her life.

item.title: Hillary Clinton, Jill Biden, Oprah Winfrey and others honor Gloria Steinem, who has died at 92
In Gloria Steinem’s last book, stories of hope and a wish to live to 100
